parameters.jsCode:
const appt = $('Cancel: find').first().json;               // the slot that just opened
const waiting = $input.all()
  .map(i => i.json)
  .filter(w => w.status === 'waiting')                        // blank 1: who is eligible?
  .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.joined_at) - new Date(b.joined_at));   // earliest sign-up first
return waiting.slice(0, 3).map(w => ({ json: {          // blank 2: how many offers at once?
  ...w,
  appt_id: appt.appt_id,
  service: appt.service,
  start_time: appt.start_time
} }));
